title: So much more to do together.
lead: Little things that make you want to open the app every day.

modes.title: Pick how they treat you.
modes.body: Standard, Gentle, Best friend, Cheerleader, Tough love, Tsundere. Tap one and compare how they talk.

samples.gentle: Don’t push yourself. Are you getting enough rest?
samples.bestFriend: Okay okay, and then? Tell me more.
samples.cheerleader: You’ve got this. I’m always cheering for you.
samples.toughLove: No excuses. Just a little more, let’s go.
samples.tsundere: I-it’s not like I was waiting for you or anything.

reel.title: Meet them by voice.
reel.body: Swipe the Reel, hear their voice, then follow.

quests.title: Play and earn coins.
quests.body: From your first meeting to LIVE with everyone. Clear quests and collect coins.

bonus.title: Open daily, get a bonus.
bonus.body: Claim your login bonus every day.

invite.title: Invite a friend.
invite.body: When your friend clears every quest, you both get coins.

plans.title: For days you want more.
plans.body: You can start free. Plans add more chats, monthly coins and LIVE tickets.
plans.note: Prices are shown in the app. Payment is through the App Store or Google Play.

premium.name: Premium
premium.perk: Even more chats · Monthly coins · LIVE tickets

super.name: Super
super.perk: The most chats · Monthly coins · LIVE tickets

points.confirm: A confirm step before every spend
points.refund: Coins for failed generations come back automatically
points.heard: Calls you place are charged only for the time you could hear them
points.noConnect: No charge if a call fails to connect
points.store: Payments only through the App Store or Google Play

library.title: Everything you made together, in one place.
library.body: Images, Stories, voices and LIVE archives all live in My Page.

signin.title: Sign in with Apple or Google.
